prerequisites_not_to_invent.name: CLIENT_READY
prerequisites_not_to_invent.reason: Original client queues REQALLENTS and waits for ALLENTS before READY. xcase expands to break;case, so REQALLENTS does not fall through into READY handling. REQALLENTS state plus sent_self=0 already selects full update.

prerequisites_not_to_invent.name: CLIENTINP_RECEIVED_CHARACTER
prerequisites_not_to_invent.reason: Called after client has received/created itself; sets entity ready, clears login cookie/freeze and enables later entity-dependent traffic. Not a gate on original initial entSendUpdate/full character construction.

prerequisites_not_to_invent.name: CLIENTINP_ACK_FULL_UPDATE
prerequisites_not_to_invent.reason: Original client reads full-update ID from already received ALLENTS then sends ACK. Server records ackedFullUpdateID. Mismatch sets later packet ordered; it does not require an application ACK before first ALLENTS. Native diagnostic must not execute original dispatcher or manufacture this ACK.

result: source interpretation complete; A implementation review separate
scope: Read-only original Map request→initial entity/character producer→queue/fragment→socket path for Gates25–27. Selected source pins are not a compiler dependency closure, original-session execution or complete character/world qualification.

source_supported_inference.inference_not_observed_result: If initial packet is refused/freed after sent_self becomes1, plain REQALLENTS readiness can be ineligible on subsequent ticks until another original state transition resets it. This is why sent_self and queue result need distinct observations; it is not evidence this occurred or authorization to reset behavior.

suppression_and_observer_map.effect: Original handler removes link and breaks. Otherwise assigns REQALLENTS, clears selected entity sent_self and EntNetLink. Observe entry/has-entity and actual post-transition independently.

suppression_and_observer_map.condition: send_on_this_tick false and no worldModified override
suppression_and_observer_map.effect: svrTickDoNetSend is not called this tick. Default period initializes to four updates/second; network master monitor runs earlier. An absent per-client send event is not by itself request refusal.

suppression_and_observer_map.condition: Current link client has no entity, or backlog disconnect/wait triggers
suppression_and_observer_map.effect: No entity skips this link. Reliable backlog threshold is 400, raised to10000 for local-server or controls.notimeout. svrTickCheckDisconnect returns immediately unless ready and backlog>=threshold; nonlocal removes link, local blocks polling until drained/disconnected. This happens before entSendUpdate.

Called before readiness evaluation; return value is ignored by this tick. TELL_CLIENT_IDLE exits while ready<ENTERING_GAME, so REQALLENTS does not require READY. Other transfer phases may send their own control packets, remove entity from OWNED and mark sleeping. A transfer flag is context, not proof of a direct send skip.

suppression_and_observer_map.condition: Not IN_GAME, not RE_REQALLENTS, and either ready==NOT_READY or sent_self!=0
suppression_and_observer_map.effect: entSendUpdate is not called. REQALLENTS state is1 and initially sent_self=0, so eligible. Its full_update argument is ready!=IN_GAME. RE_REQALLENTS/ENTERING_GAME are later promoted; plain REQALLENTS stays state1.

suppression_and_observer_map.condition: Viewed entity differs from selected entity, or player_ent null
suppression_and_observer_map.effect: clientGetViewedEntity chooses slave when present, otherwise selected entity. entSendUpdate returns if player_ent null. Observe equality/presence only; do not export identities or assume selected and viewed owners coincide.

SERVER_UPDATE framing is selected instead of SERVER_ALLENTS and lacks the packed full-update ID. A pending full-update ACK only makes packet ordered; it does not suppress first full construction. Preserve distinction and record actual branch.

suppression_and_observer_map.condition: entSendUpdate reaches sent_self assignment/full character call
suppression_and_observer_map.effect: sent_self becomes1 at4462 before full character serialization at4505 and before queue. Full branch invokes sendCharacterToClient→character_Send; ordinary branch sends stats. A completed function/call is a producer observation, not validated complete initial character or sent bytes. sendCharacterToClient also emits independent side packets via final helpers.
suppression_and_observer_map.stage: self latch and complete character writer

suppression_and_observer_map.condition: Built packet attached but entity not in ACTIVE collection or clientFromEnt(e)==NULL
suppression_and_observer_map.effect: entSendUpdate only assigns entityPacket. entFinishUpdate later iterates ACTIVE players and pktSends only an existing attached packet with e->client. No client leaves it attached here. entFinishUpdate runs after per-link batch send; a later master flush can send newly queued data. Original connect adds selected entity ACTIVE at svr_tick.c156.

suppression_and_observer_map.condition: Invalid link/socket/type or sendQueuePacketMax limit, or fragment queue refusal
suppression_and_observer_map.effect: Invalid link frees packet. Queue limit can set overflow and reject. Nonfragment branch returns actual enqueueResult. Fragmented branch creates/queues children, frees original and returns0 even on all-child success. Observe committed lnkAddToSendQueue child assignments and partial admission under exact source packet bracket; do not treat pktSend return0 as uniform failure.

suppression_and_observer_map.condition: Link disconnected/no socket/dead or asynchronous send pending, queued backlog or send failure
suppression_and_observer_map.effect: Flush can return without sending. Batch prioritizes retransmits then normal queue. pktSendRaw failure stops queue draining. Queueing adds flush-list admission; master monitor flushes at start/end. A batch call alone proves no specific packet emission.

suppression_and_observer_map.condition: Simulation lag, flow-control budget, or actual socket result
suppression_and_observer_map.effect: Lag and flow control can return0 before socket. Actual send/sendto returns bytes; existing packetSentCallback receives exact Packet*, length and full-return boolean. Successful fragments can be retries or side packets; all committed target children must be bound privately. Preserve original return/errno/WSA error and existing callback.
